name: Failure-Domain and RTO/RPO Definition
description: Inventory all failure domains across the Tribunus architecture: PGlite durable store, Valkey coordination kernel, DuckDB analytical layer, filesystem attachments, desktop device, federation network, cloud region/cell, and extension runtime. For each domain, define recovery-time objective (RTO) and recovery-point objective (RPO) with tiered service levels. Map dependencies between domains to identify cascading failure and recovery paths. Produce failure-domain map with SLI/SLO baselines for each domain.
purpose: Clear RTO/RPO definitions per failure domain are the foundation for designing backup contracts, restore contracts, disaster simulation, and recovery certification. Without these, reliability targets are aspirational rather than measurable.
acceptanceCriteria: Failure-domain map identifies all failure domains with dependency graph showing cascading failure paths
RTO/RPO table defines tiered objectives per domain with SLI/SLO baselines
Architecture document covers recovery priority order and inter-domain recovery coordination
